abstract: This project presents the development of Pro Sales, a web-based system designed to improve sales productivity for the Japanese Sales Team at Adecco, a global recruitment and human resources company operating in Thailand. The system aims to support sales representatives in managing prospect companies, organizing outreach activities, and identifying potential clients more efficiently through a centralized platform. Another objective of the project is to organize and centralize the sales team's company database, which was previously stored across multiple Excel files. The system consolidates these datasets into a structured relational database while ensuring that all information is stored locally within the organization to address data privacy concerns. Pro Sales is developed using modern web technologies, including React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, to provide an efficient and scalable solution for managing sales data and improving overall sales operations.

committee: Asst. Prof. Dr. Dobri Atanassov Batovski
abstract: Daily transportation often faces challenges such as traffic congestion, high travel costs, and environmental pollution. Many individuals travel to similar destinations using separate vehicles, which leads to inefficient transportation and increased traffic. Hop-On RideShare is a ride-sharing platform designed to connect users who are traveling in the same direction. The application allows users to post rides, view available rides, and join shared trips easily through a mobile application. By enabling users to share rides, the system helps reduce travel costs, decrease traffic congestion, and promote eco-friendly transportation. The application integrates features such as ride management, real-time map navigation, and communication between users. It is developed using Android technologies with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, supported by MongoDB and Google Maps APIs for location and routing services.
